description: Application for a Minor Material Amendment (S73a) to vary condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission ref: 250440FUL dated 09/04/2025 for: Construction of dwellinghouse with habitable roof space with provision of private amenity, cycle storage, refuse storage and parking provision (following demolition of the existing garage/workshop at 12A Emanuel Avenue ); single storey rear extension (following demolition of existing side extension at 14 Emanuel Avenue); alterations to rear first floor fenestration involving enlargement of Juliet balcony (Joint Application). Amendment seeks adjustment of outrigger ridge line to align with main roof ridge; reduction in depth of single-storey rear extension to align with rear face of outrigger; partial enlargement of building footprint along the western boundary
